# Lindisfare Ferries - nightly booking reconciliation

The service checks every booking taken during the day and writes one line per
check. The closing SUMMARY line is composed from the counters the writer had
at the end of the run.

    <time> booking=<ref> card_check ok | cvv_mismatch
